_what: EA-CORPORA-18 seat specification: ten seats of the modern avant-garde and its sources, public domain in the United States (published before 1931, or by an author public domain in the source country on 1 January 1996). Read by build_seats.py. Every locus listed here is kept only if the string is found in the seated text; the builder reports any that are not.
_ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-15: "we need more seatings of avant garde literature. dada. farce. oulipo. futurist. - whatevers in the public domain. originals is good on classics, impoverished on modern. and i want the italian troubadours. and pound, more pound. need the cantos." — "and the concrete poets" — "also need jarry, shklovsky, etc" — "it gets an ea-corpora deposit and a spine and a card on tll, bulk seatings per ea-corpora deposit is fine".

seats.scope: Seated beside card 05/02 (Personae, Lustra, Cathay, Poems 1918–21 with Cantos IV–VII), which is left as deposited. THE CANTOS: the seatable Cantos are those printed before 1931. Three Cantos (Poetry, 1917) are seated here; Cantos IV–VII are in 05/02 (Poems 1918–21). A Draft of XVI Cantos (Paris: Three Mountains Press, 1925), A Draft of the Cantos 17–27 (London: John Rodker, 1928) and A Draft of XXX Cantos (Paris: Hours Press, 1930) are public domain in the United States, but no public-domain witness was reachable from the session: the Internet Archive holds only the 1990 New Directions reprint, lending-restricted; HathiTrust is not reachable from this workspace. QUEUED: the periodical first printings 1922–1930 (The Dial, The Criterion, The Transatlantic Review), located on the Internet Archive and not yet read for the Canto pages. Cantos XXXI onward are in copyright in the United States (Eleven New Cantos, 1934 → 2030) and are not seated.
seats.why_seated: More Pound, and the Cantos from their first printing. Three Cantos (1917) open by arguing with Browning's Sordello — the series Browning, Pound, Pessoa that cards 05/01–05/03 measure, now with its hinge in print. The Cavalcanti of 1912 is Pound's Italian source on the facing page, and The Spirit of Romance is his map of the Provençal and Italian lyric that card 18/02 seats in its own languages.

seats.scope: The poets Pound calls the Tuscans and Dante calls the dolce stil novo, with the Sicilian court of Frederick II before them and the comic-realist and religious poets beside them, in editions a reader of 1910 could open. NOT SEATED: the Italians who wrote in Occitan — Sordello, Lanfranc Cigala, Bonifaci Calvo, Rambertino Buvalelli — no public-domain edition was located in the session; QUEUED. Modern critical editions (Contini, Poeti del Duecento, 1960; Antonelli, I poeti della Scuola siciliana, 2008) are in copyright and are not seated: they are the finding aids this seat routes around, back to the editions they correct.
seats.why_seated: The Italian troubadours, and the source of the Cavalcanti Pound translated and the Dante's circle Rossetti translated. The originals shelf held Dante's Commedia nowhere and the duecento lyric not at all; this seat brings the canzone and the sonnet in at their invention.

seats.scope: Books and first printings to 1923. The Futurist journals (Poesia, Lacerba) are on the Internet Archive issue by issue and are not seated here: QUEUED as a separate run. Blast 2 (1915) is access-restricted on the Internet Archive (HTTP 401) and is not seated. Kruchenykh and Khlebnikov's Победа над солнцем (1913) not located in a public-domain witness; QUEUED.
seats.why_seated: The movement that put the word on the page as an object. Parole in libertà and zaum are the two ends of the operation the archive calls a constructed language: Marinetti's typography makes the sentence a field; Kruchenykh's 'дыр бул щыл' makes a word that answers to nothing before it.

seats.why_seated: Jarry is the root of the line from farce to the Oulipo: Ubu is the farce that broke the theatre, and pataphysics — 'the science of imaginary solutions' — is the science the Oulipo was founded inside, as a sub-commission of the Collège de 'Pataphysique.

Allais's blank rectangle, 'Première communion de jeunes filles chlorotiques par un temps de neige' (the Incohérents, 1883; printed in the Album primo-avrilesque, 1897), is the monochrome thirty years before Malevich and the joke Dada would make a programme.

seats.scope: The Oulipo itself (founded 1960; Queneau, Perec, Calvino, Roubaud) is in copyright and is not seated. What is seated is the line the Oulipo named for itself: its 'plagiaires par anticipation'. Roussel's Comment j'ai écrit certains de mes livres (1935) is in copyright in the United States until 2031 and is not seated; Impressions d'Afrique (1910) was not located on the reachable sources in this pass; QUEUED.
seats.why_seated: Constraint as the engine of a text. Roussel built his novels from homophones and Carroll built his poems from rules; both are the precedent for treating a procedure, rather than an intention, as the author of a sentence.

seats.scope: Concrete poetry proper (Gomringer, 1953; the Noigandres group, 1952; Finlay; Garnier) is in copyright and is not seated. What is seated is its line: the late-antique grid poem, Mallarmé's spatial page and Apollinaire's figured verse, with the Futurist parole in libertà (Marinetti's Zang Tumb Tuuum, Govoni's Rarefazioni) in card 18/03 and Morgenstern's typographic poems in 18/07. The Hellenistic technopaegnia (Simmias, Theocritus's Syrinx) are in the theocritus seat and the Greek Anthology. Rabanus Maurus's In honorem sanctae crucis and George Herbert's 'Easter Wings' were not located in this pass; QUEUED.
seats.why_seated: The concrete poets, as far back as the public domain reaches. A poem whose layout is part of its meaning cannot be seated as running text alone, so this seat carries the scans.

seats.scope: Shklovsky's Воскрешение слова (1914), Zoo (1923), Ход коня (1923) and Третья фабрика (1926) were not located on the reachable sources; QUEUED. Архаисты и новаторы (Tynyanov, 1929) is on the Internet Archive only in a scan filed under 1985 and is not seated until its printing is established. Jakobson's Новейшая русская поэзия (Prague, 1921) not located; QUEUED. Text layers are the Internet Archive's OCR, uncorrected; the scans are the witnesses.
seats.why_seated: Shklovsky's device, and the school that read Futurism (card 18/03) as it happened: «Искусство как прием» is the theory of what zaum and parole in libertà do — make the word strange so it can be seen. Tynyanov's parody essay is the theory of the move the archive's heteronymic practice makes.
